entities.summary: Air Algérie Flight 702P was a domestic flight operated by a Boeing 737 owned by Air Algérie under lease to Phoenix Aviation. On 21 December 1994, in low visibility conditions, it collided with power transmission cables and a pylon during its final approach to Coventry Airport in the United Kingdom. The aircraft subsequently overturned and damaged several houses before crashing inverted into a wooded area beyond. All five people on board were killed.
